articles.summary: Dan Johnson visits one of the country's largest power stations, barely left standing after a ballistic missile strike by Russia.
articles.body:
As peace talks between Ukraine and Russia continue, Ukrainians are facing a rolling schedule of planned power cuts because of intensified Russian attacks on their energy grid. Ukraine has responded by striking Russian oil refineries.

Officials are concerned that life will quickly become unsustainable for millions of Ukrainians if power supplies cannot be maintained for at least four hours per day. Some privately warn that's close already, as some families are living with outages of up to 20 hours in Kyiv.

Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson visits one of the country's power stations on the front lines of the war. Devastated by a direct ballistic missile strike, repair work is hampered by frequent air raids.

articles.title: Como suposto novo caso extraconjugal de CEO da Nvidia aumenta pressão para que ele saia do cargo | G1
articles.standfirst: A empresa contratou um grande escritório de advocacia para investigar o relacionamento dele com uma mulher suspeita de ser espiã da China.
articles.summary: A empresa contratou um grande escritório de advocacia para investigar o relacionamento dele com uma mulher suspeita de ser espiã da China.
articles.body:
A gigante americana de tecnologia Nvidia está avaliando nesta quinta-feira (12) se seu presidente-executivo, Jensen Huang, permanecerá na empresa, segundo relatos da imprensa.

Mais recentemente, porém, o conselho de administração da companhia se reuniu enquanto suas ações despencavam após reportagens sobre um segundo suposto caso extraconjugal envolvendo Huang.

O jornal New York Times alega que Huang também teve um caso com uma funcionária da Nvidia .

A The Economist defendeu, em artigo publicado na quarta-feira (11), que o presidente-executivo deve renunciar ao cargo ou ser demitido.

"Mesmo que nenhuma outra revelação comprometedora venha à tona, a permanência de Huang no cargo é insustentável. Ele deve renunciar ou ser demitido", diz o texto.

O conselho da Nvidia havia demonstrado apoio a Huang, afirmando que não tinha motivos para acreditar que segredos da empresa ou a segurança nacional tivessem sido comprometidos em decorrência do primeiro caso extraconjugal.

Até o fim da noite de quarta-feira, o conselho da Nvidia não havia divulgado nenhum comunicado. Ligações para diversos representantes da empresa e integrantes do conselho não foram respondidas.

Jensen Huang, CEO da Nvidia, participa de fórum em Berlim, na Alemanha, em 19 de outubro de 2026 — Foto: Lisi Niesner/Reuters

As ações da Nvidia , a segunda empresa mais valiosa do mundo, atrás apenas da Apple, despencaram quase 7,5% nas negociações após o fechamento do mercado.

A gigante fabricante de chips encerrou o dia em alta em Wall Street, após dias difíceis desde a divulgação do caso extraconjugal.

Grandes empresas de investimento também rebaixaram suas recomendações para as ações da empresa em meio à crescente preocupação com a governança da companhia.

As empresas financeiras Baird e Bernstein Research rebaixaram suas perspectivas para as ações da Nvidia , enquanto o Morgan Stanley retirou os papéis de sua lista de investimentos favoritos.

O principal analista da Bernstein, Stacy Rasgon, reduziu pela metade seu preço-alvo para as ações. "Nossa intuição nos diz que provavelmente ainda não exploramos a fundo tudo o que pode ser descoberto aqui", escreveu.

Desde que o escândalo veio à tona, a Nvidia perdeu quase meio trilhão de dólares em valor de mercado.

A gigante americana de tecnologia é avaliada em cerca de US$ 4,5 trilhões (R$ 25,1 trilhões) e é uma das principais fornecedoras de chips avançados.

É considerada uma das empresas mais importantes por trás da expansão da inteligência artificial (IA), por ser a única fabricante de um chip usado em ferramentas de IA.

Esses chips também são essenciais para todo tipo de tecnologia, de videogames e veículos autônomos a enormes centros de dados e servidores em nuvem.

🔍 A China é a maior concorrente dos Estados Unidos na corrida para desenvolver os sistemas de IA mais poderosos, e Washington restringe desde 2022 as exportações dos chips mais avançados da Nvidia para o país asiático.

Os Estados Unidos justificam as restrições às exportações por motivos de segurança nacional, argumentando que essas vendas poderiam ampliar a capacidade militar da China, embora algumas restrições tenham sido flexibilizadas sob o governo do presidente Trump.

A possível saída de Jensen Huang da Nvidia está se desenrolando como uma tragédia grega ou shakespeariana, diz Bob O'Donnell, analista-chefe da Technalysis Research, à BBC News.

Uma eventual saída levantaria dúvidas sobre quem assumiria o comando e como essa pessoa mudaria a empresa nos próximos anos, afirma O'Donnell.

"É difícil de acreditar", diz ele. "[Huang] é uma figura extraordinária... um grande visionário."

A Nvidia enfrenta "uma grave crise de governança" e precisará decidir se os benefícios da permanência de Huang superam a desconfiança entre as partes interessadas, acrescenta R Ray Wang, da Constellation Research.

Segundo ele, o escândalo representa uma crise mais para a Nvidia do que para o setor de IA.

A empresa precisa avaliar se um possível substituto de Huang teria a mesma capacidade de estabelecer parcerias de igual porte, diz.

"Essa é a verdadeira questão... porque muitas dessas parcerias e investimentos foram feitos graças à confiança em Jensen."

EUA devem 'parar de inventar' acusações de espionagem, diz China

Em entrevista coletiva diária do Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China, em Pequim, a porta-voz Mao Ning disse à BBC News que os Estados Unidos "devem parar de inventar supostas narrativas de espionagem para encontrar pretextos para impor bloqueios tecnológicos".

"O progresso científico e tecnológico da China é impulsionado pela inovação independente e pela cooperação aberta", disse.

"A China e os Estados Unidos têm mantido uma comunicação próxima sobre as interações entre os dois chefes de Estado. A China está disposta a trabalhar com os Estados Unidos para implementar plenamente os importantes entendimentos alcançados entre os dois chefes de Estado e promover a construção de uma relação sino-americana construtiva e estrategicamente estável, baseada no respeito, na equidade e na reciprocidade", afirmou.

articles.title: Brasileiros são presos na Tailândia com R$ 3,3 milhões em cocaína | G1
articles.standfirst: Departamento de Alfândega tailandês afirmou que os detidos, que haviam saído do Brasil por meio do aeroporto de Guarulhos, tentaram entrar no país asiático com 6,8 kg de drogas.
articles.summary: Brasileiros presos na Tailândia tentaram entrar no país com 6,8 kg de cocaína escondidos em malas; a droga é avaliada em R$ 3,3 milhões pelas autoridades locais.
articles.body:
Brasileiros são presos na Tailândia em 8 de novembro de 2026 com 6,1kg de cocaína. — Foto: Reprodução / Alfândega da Tailândia

O departamento de alfândega da Tailândia informou que dois brasileiros foram detidos enquanto tentavam entrar no país com 6,8 kg de cocaína. A prisão aconteceu em 8 de novembro.

Eles teriam partido de um voo em Guarulhos com destino ao aeroporto de Suvarnabhumi, na Tailândia. A substância estaria escondida em compartimentos secretos no piso e nas paredes das malas vistoriadas.

De acordo com as autoridades locais, o valor estimado da droga apreendida é de 20.400.000 baht, moeda tailandesa. Convertido em reais no câmbio desta quinta-feira (12), o total chega a cerca de R$ 3,38 milhões.

Departamento de alfândega da Tailândia encontra cocaína em malas de brasileiros presos em 8 de novembro de 2026. — Foto: Reprodução / Alfândega da Tailândia

Outros brasileiros foram presos na Tailândia com cocaína em 2022

A Tailândia é conhecida por aplicar penas duras a turistas apreendidos com drogas no país.

Em 2022, a mineira Mary Hellen Coelho Silva foi presa junto a outros dois brasileiros em Bangkok . Após revista na mala dos três, foram encontrados 9 kg de cocaína.

Em entrevista à EPTV Sul de Minas , afiliada da TV Globo, Mary Hellen afirmou que acabou sendo condenada a 7 anos de prisão e uma multa de cerca de R$ 109 mil. Acabou sendo liberada antes do fim da pena por bom comportamento e, posteriormente, recebeu o chamado "perdão real coletivo".

articles.title: Crise na Nvidia: veja como o caso começou e levou à renúncia de Jensen Huang, fundador da empresa | G1
articles.standfirst: Queda das ações, investigação do FBI, conversa com Donald Trump e processo movido por acionistas marcaram as últimas semanas da fabricante de chips até a saída do CEO.
articles.summary: Queda das ações, investigação do FBI, conversa com Donald Trump e processo movido por acionistas marcaram as últimas semanas da fabricante de chips até a saída do CEO.
articles.body:
Uma suspeita de espionagem, casos extraconjugais e segurança nacional dos Estados Unidos colocaram a Nvidia no centro de uma crise que levou à renúncia de seu fundador, Jensen Huang, nesta quinta-feira (12) .

A saída ocorreu após semanas de revelações que preocuparam investidores e levantaram dúvidas sobre a segurança das informações da empresa. Veja, em ordem cronológica, como o caso começou e levou à mudança no comando da Nvidia.

Toque ou clique nos itens abaixo para entender a linha do tempo da crise:

Primeiro caso extraconjugal é descoberto

A crise começou no fim de outubro, quando o governo dos Estados Unidos suspeitou que uma executiva chinesa do setor de tecnologia teria atuado como agente de inteligência de Pequim , enquanto mantinha contato próximo com Jensen Huang.

Segundo o The New York Times, Alice Huang, também identificada como Huang Le, era uma das principais executivas da Megaspeed, empresa de data centers sediada em Singapura. Autoridades americanas concluíram que ela repassava informações à China - o governo chinês negou a espionagem .

Alice Huang participando de um jantar organizado pelo CEO e cofundador da Nvidia. — Foto: AFP

Apesar do sobrenome em comum, ela não tem parentesco com Jensen Huang, de 63 anos, nascido em Taiwan.

Segundo o jornal, a Megaspeed comprou mais de US$ 4,8 bilhões em chips da Nvidia nos últimos dois anos . Autoridades dos Estados Unidos investigaram os envios, sob suspeita de Alice ter ajudado Pequim a obter acesso a chips avançados de inteligência artificial cuja exportação para a China é proibida.

Já na primeira semana de agosto, uma investigação independente foi aberta na Nvidia para apurar se Huang foi alvo de uma operação de inteligência estrangeira.

Em mensagem enviada aos funcionários da Nvidia, obtida pela Reuters, o executivo confirmou o relacionamento extraconjugal e assumiu "total responsabilidade" por seus atos.

“Fui infiel à minha esposa. Minhas ações fizeram mal a ela e aos nossos filhos. Não há desculpa para o que fiz”, escreveu Huang.

Os efeitos da investigação chegaram à Coreia do Sul, onde Madison Huang, filha do executivo e também funcionária da Nvidia, cancelou uma viagem a Seul.

Ela participaria de uma conferência da empresa, prevista para começar nesta segunda-feira, segundo companhias com as quais tinha reuniões agendadas.

Jensen Huang, CEO da Nvidia, ao lado de Donald Trump, presidente dos Estados Unidos, em foto de 8 de outubro de 2026 — Foto: Reuters/Evan Vucci

Trump disse ter conversado com Huang, que disse que não sabia que a mulher era uma espiã. "Eu realmente acredito nele", disse o republicano. "Eu sei que o FBI está investigando. Ele ficará em uma situação confortável".

Já nos últimos dias a crise fez com que acionistas processassem Nvidia e Jensen Huang . O escritório de advocacia americano Rosen Law Firm apresentou um pedido de ação coletiva que acusa Huang e a Nvidia de enganar os acionistas ao ocultar informações sobre a relação e os possíveis riscos que ela representava para a empresa.

Novo caso, agora com executiva da própria Nvidia

Na última quarta-feira (12), o jornal The New York Times afirmou que Jensen Huang, teria mantido outro relacionamento extraconjugal, desta vez com Kimberly Powell , executiva da própria empresa, que responde diretamente a ele.

Kimberly Powell, vice-presidente da área de saúde da Nvidia, que teria se relacionado com CEO da empresa. — Foto: Kimberly Powell/Reprodução

De acordo com o jornal, Huang e Powell teriam sido vistos em uma situação de intimidade em um hotel de San Jose, na Califórnia, durante uma conferência da empresa, em março.

articles.title: VÍDEO: chuva de granizo provoca danos em Piraju | G1
articles.standfirst: Temporal acompanhado de descargas elétricas também afetou a rede telefônica do Departamento Municipal de Serviços. Não há registro de feridos.
articles.summary: Uma chuva acompanhada de granizo e descargas elétricas atingiu Piraju (SP) na madrugada desta quinta-feira (12) e provocou estragos na cidade.
articles.body:
Uma chuva acompanhada de granizo e descargas elétricas atingiu Piraju (SP) na madrugada desta quinta-feira (12) e provocou estragos na cidade.

Segundo a prefeitura, a chuva causou danos em estradas da zona rural e na rede elétrica do Departamento Municipal de Serviços, o que também comprometeu o sistema telefônico do órgão. Não há registro de feridos.

Chuva com granizo atinge Piraju — Foto: Divulgação/Prefeitura de Piraju

A chuva começou por volta das 3h, acompanhada de granizo e raios. De acordo com a administração municipal, as equipes trabalham para avaliar os danos e os impactos causados pelo temporal.

Por causa dos danos, o atendimento administrativo e os serviços internos do Departamento Municipal de Serviços estão temporariamente comprometidos.

Segundo o Departamento de Obras, também foram registrados estragos em estradas da zona rural, principalmente nas regiões do Santoro, Félix e Cágado.

A Prefeitura informou que acompanha a situação e trabalha para restabelecer a normalidade dos serviços.

Enquanto isso, os moradores que precisarem de atendimento podem entrar em contato pelo telefone (14) 3305-9000.

articles.title: Ações da Nvidia despencam após renúncia de Jensen Huang | G1
articles.standfirst: Fundador da gigante de chips admitiu infidelidade à esposa em meio a investigação sobre possível operação de inteligência chinesa. Companhia já perdeu mais de US$ 1 trilhão em valor de mercado em oito pregões.
articles.summary: Fundador da gigante de chips admitiu infidelidade à esposa em meio a investigação sobre possível operação de inteligência chinesa.
articles.body:
As ações da Nvidia , gigante americana do setor de chips, abriram o pregão desta quinta-feira (12) em forte queda na Nasdaq, bolsa de Nova York que concentra grandes empresas de tecnologia. Os papéis chegaram a cair 13,90% , cotados a US$ 149,57 .

Por volta das 14h33 (horário de Brasília), as ações da Nvidia reduziam as perdas, mas ainda recuavam 5,25% , cotadas a US$ 164,61 . O valor de mercado da Nvidia era de aproximadamente US$ 3,86 trilhões (R$ 21,6 trilhões).

A queda ocorre em meio à saída de Jensen Huang do comando da companhia , após a abertura de uma investigação relacionada a um suposto relacionamento extraconjugal com uma empresária chinesa alvo de suspeitas de espionagem.

Mais cedo, no pré-mercado, os papéis já registravam queda de 11,56%. Em um mês, as ações da Nvidia acumulam perdas de 24,23%.

Segundo o conselho de administração da Nvidia, Huang deixou os cargos de presidente, diretor-executivo e integrante do colegiado, com efeito imediato.

A empresa informou que Colette Kress, vice-presidente executiva e diretora financeira, assumirá interinamente o comando da companhia.

"Durante seu mandato, ela liderou a organização financeira da empresa e desempenhou um papel fundamental no crescimento e evolução da empresa. Antes de ingressar na Nvidia, Kress passou quase 25 anos em cargos financeiros em empresas líderes de tecnologia, incluindo Cisco e Microsoft", afirmou a companhia em comunicado.

Cofundador da Nvidia, Huang admitiu ter sido infiel à esposa em meio às suspeitas de espionagem. No domingo (8), a empresa anunciou a abertura de uma investigação independente para apurar se o executivo teria sido alvo de uma operação de inteligência estrangeira.

Nvidia perdeu mais de US$ 1 trilhão em valor de mercado

Antes mesmo da queda registrada nesta quinta-feira, a Nvidia já havia perdido US$ 1,081 trilhão (cerca de R$ 6,1 trilhões) em valor de mercado entre 29 de outubro e 10 de novembro, segundo levantamento da Elos Ayta.

Em apenas oito pregões, o valor de mercado da companhia caiu de US$ 5,149 trilhões para US$ 4,068 trilhões , uma redução de aproximadamente 21%. Nos dois últimos pregões desse período, as perdas somaram US$ 430 bilhões (cerca de R$ 2,3 trilhões).

Para dimensionar a queda, o levantamento compara as perdas da Nvidia ao valor de mercado de todas as empresas brasileiras listadas na bolsa, que juntas somam aproximadamente US$ 888 bilhões (R$ 4,8 trilhões).

🔎 Isso significa que a Nvidia perdeu, em apenas oito pregões, o equivalente a 1,22 vez o valor de mercado de todas as companhias brasileiras listadas na bolsa. Em reais, as perdas da Nvidia superam esse valor em mais de R$ 1 trilhão.

Outra comparação ajuda a mostrar a dimensão das perdas. Os três setores mais valiosos da bolsa brasileira — bancos, petróleo e energia elétrica — reúnem 55 empresas, com valor de mercado conjunto de US$ 449 bilhões (cerca de R$ 2,4 trilhões), segundo a Elos Ayta.

Desse total, US$ 207 bilhões (R$ 1,1 trilhão) correspondem a 18 bancos; US$ 138 bilhões (R$ 745 bilhões), a oito empresas do setor de petróleo; e US$ 104 bilhões (R$ 562 bilhões), a 29 companhias de energia elétrica.

O suposto relacionamento entre Jensen Huang e Alice Huang foi divulgado pelo jornal "The New York Times" em outubro. Segundo a publicação, a empresária teria sido recrutada pelo governo chinês para obter informações sobre o executivo.

Em mensagem enviada aos funcionários da Nvidia, à qual a Reuters teve acesso, Huang teria confirmado o relacionamento extraconjugal e assumido “total responsabilidade” por seus atos.

"Fui infiel à minha esposa. Minhas ações fizeram mal a ela e aos nossos filhos. Não há desculpa para o que fiz", escreveu.

Na mesma mensagem, dirigida a colegas, ao conselho de administração, aos parceiros e aos acionistas, ele afirmou que continuava comprometido com a empresa.

“Minha responsabilidade é servir a vocês e ser digno da confiança de vocês. Não estive à altura dessa responsabilidade”, declarou.

Pessoa passa por painel com logomarca da Nvidia na Computex em Taiwan em junho de 2024 — Foto: Ann Wang/Reuters

articles.title: ExpoBeleza 2026 em Manaus: Confira a programação e expositores | G1
articles.standfirst: Feira é voltada a profissionais e empreendedores das áreas de beleza, estética e barbearia, como cabeleireiros, maquiadores, biomédicos estetas e proprietários de salões.
articles.summary: A ExpoBeleza 2026 em Manaus reúne 100 expositores e oferece workshops gratuitos sobre estética e barbearia para profissionais no Centro de Convenções Vasco Vasques.
articles.body:
A ExpoBeleza 2026 será realizada neste domingo (15) e próxima segunda-feira (16), no Centro de Convenções Vasco Vasques, em Manaus . O evento espera receber mais de 7 mil visitantes e reunir mais de 100 expositores em um espaço dedicado a negócios, lançamentos, tendências e capacitação no setor da beleza.

A feira é voltada a profissionais e empreendedores das áreas de beleza, estética e barbearia, como cabeleireiros, maquiadores, biomédicos estetas e proprietários de salões. A programação inclui palestras, workshops, masterclasses e apresentações sobre técnicas e tendências do mercado .

O pavilhão principal terá estandes de marcas do setor, com lançamentos de produtos e oportunidades de negociação diretamente com fabricantes.

O credenciamento gratuito para profissionais de beleza, estética e barbearia deve ser feito pelo site oficial do evento ( manausexpobeleza.com.br ). As condições para emissão de certificados variam conforme a atividade.

No primeiro dia, domingo (15) , a programação começa às 15h , com uma palestra sobre o corte butterfly, apresentada pelo especialista Severo Muniz. Em seguida, às 16h , Tatiana Jansen fala sobre skincare coreano.

Às 18h , o público poderá acompanhar o show "Vestido de Noiva, Ancestralidade Sustentável", da estilista Valdirlene Marques.

Na segunda (16) , as atividades começam às 8h , com workshops práticos sobre injetáveis faciais e harmonização glútea. As masterclasses serão conduzidas pelos esteticistas Renato Lima e Renato Barreto, conforme a programação divulgada pelo evento.

Às 11h05, Soon Hee Hab apresenta a palestra "A bioeconomia do transformar: A ancestralidade criando um futuro possível para a beleza e o bem-estar".

A programação segue à tarde com outras atividades:

articles.title: Máquina parada não é opção: como a Jacto prioriza o agricultor no atendimento | G1
articles.standfirst: Sem chatbot, com contato direto com a fábrica e parceria com revendas, a Jacto mantém a proximidade com o produtor rural construída ao longo de 78 anos de história.
articles.summary: Sem chatbot, com contato direto com a fábrica e parceria com revendas, a Jacto mantém a proximidade com o produtor rural construída ao longo de 78 anos de história.
articles.body:
Para mais agilidade na safra, Jacto oferece suporte direto com a fábrica — Foto: Jacto/Divulgação

Quando um pulverizador para no meio da safra, o produtor não quer digitar “1” para falar com o suporte nem preencher formulário, quer falar com alguém que resolva. Na Jacto , multinacional brasileira de máquinas, serviços e soluções agrícolas, é assim que acontece : quem liga, manda mensagem no WhatsApp, aciona o aplicativo Jacto Connect ou escreve nas redes sociais é atendido por uma pessoa da fábrica, em Pompeia (SP) . Não há robô nem chatbot na linha de frente.

“O cliente escolhe por onde quer falar, e quando ele procura a fábrica, a Jacto registra o caso, analisa a demanda do agricultor, oferece soluções e quando há necessidade de ida presencialmente na máquina, aciona a revenda Master mais próxima e acompanha o atendimento até a solução, dando o suporte preciso para que o cliente receba com agilidade e eficiência a solução necessária. Nosso objetivo é que o cliente fale com o menor número possível de pessoas até obter a resposta”, afirma Fabiano Neves, coordenador de Experiência do Cliente da Jacto. A única automação da central é a escolha de idioma para quem liga do exterior.

A proximidade sempre fez parte da história da empresa, fundada em 1948 pelo imigrante japonês Shunji Nishimura, que iniciou a empresa com uma placa “Conserta-se tudo”, essa essência direciona as estratégias atuais em Experiência do Cliente. Por décadas, o telefone gratuito (0 800) da Jacto ficou estampado nos carros da assistência técnica, quando o setor ainda nem falava em estrutura de pós-venda. Com o crescimento da operação e do número de clientes, ficou claro que esse cuidado precisava de estrutura para chegar a todos da mesma forma, com registro, prioridades e prazos definidos .

A virada veio com a mudança no comportamento do produtor, que passou a procurar a empresa por vários caminhos, movimento que a pandemia acelerou. A partir de 2019, a Jacto estruturou a Torre da Experiência do Cliente , com sistema de relacionamento (CRM), registro de todos os contatos, prioridades e metas de tempo de atendimento .

“Todo mundo fala do ‘jeito Jacto’ de atender. A experiência do cliente ajudou a transformar esse jeito com processo, tecnologia, gestão e pessoas, sem perder a essência”, resume Fabiano.

Hoje há fluxos de atendimento específicos para cada jornada do cliente, como máquina parada, divergência de peças e pré-vendas, disponibilizando atendimento com qualidade e proximidade do cliente . E há rituais de experiência do cliente que viraram cultura, como reuniões semanais com a alta liderança para acompanhar os atendimentos em andamento e agir antes que um prazo seja ultrapassado, colocando em prática o conceito de centralidade do cliente.

Equipe monitora chamados e aciona revendas para atendimento — Foto: Jacto/Divulgação

O processo de máquina parada é o exemplo mais concreto dessa mudança, com meta estabelecida de concluir o atendimento em até 48 horas no Brasil . Entre os protocolos de atendimento da Jacto estão o envio de peças com frete dedicado, pago pela própria empresa , um custo que não é repassado ao cliente nem à revenda.

A forma de medir também mudou. Em vez de considerar o atendimento encerrado quando a peça chega à revenda, a Jacto passou a contar o tempo até a máquina voltar a trabalhar.

“O que importa para o produtor é a máquina de volta à lavoura. O indicador precisa mostrar o que ele está vivendo no campo”, afirma o coordenador de Experiência do Cliente.

A escuta segue a mesma lógica. Enquanto muitas empresas realizam a pesquisa de satisfação disparando um link por SMS ou e-mail, a Jacto telefona para o cliente após entrega técnica da sua nova máquina . Quem liga é um colaborador da própria empresa, e não de uma terceirizada . A conversa é aberta: e o produtor pode aproveitar para contar sobre outro assunto de uma outra máquina Jacto , um novo chamado é aberto ali mesmo e seguimos com o fluxo de atendimento.

“O cálculo da satisfação na Jacto também segue uma metodologia mais rigorosa. Em vez de considerar apenas a média das notas atribuídas pelos clientes, aplicamos a mesma lógica do NPS, que considera o equilíbrio entre os clientes promotores, que recomendam e elogiam a marca, os neutros, e os detratores, que tiveram alguma insatisfação. Se utilizássemos apenas a média, nosso resultado seria de 8 a 10 pontos maior. Mas, para nós, mais importante do que a nota é entender quem não teve uma boa experiência, porque são esses clientes que nos ajudam a identificar oportunidades de melhoria e a construir planos de ação cada vez mais assertivos”, ressalta Fabiano.

A Jacto investe ainda em inteligência artificial de modo a apoiar o time de atendimento a encontrar soluções mais rapidamente e a padronizar respostas. Para apoiar a rede de revendas, a empresa também criou uma trilha de capacitação em experiência do cliente , iniciativa ainda rara entre fabricantes de máquinas agrícolas, e leva o tema aos encontros anuais com os revendedores, com imersões, palestras e workshops.

O próximo passo é tornar o atendimento cada vez mais proativo. Com o cruzamento de dados de telemetria e inteligência de dados, a Jacto busca identificar possíveis falhas antes mesmo que elas impactem a operação, além de aprimorar o planejamento do estoque de peças de reposição.

“No fim, o que o produtor realmente quer é ter a confiança de que poderá contar com a máquina quando precisar. Tudo o que contribui para aumentar essa disponibilidade gera mais segurança e tranquilidade para o cliente”, conclui Fabiano.

articles.title: Trump diz que ex-CEO da Nvidia fez um 'trabalho fantástico'  | G1
articles.standfirst: Norte-americano propôs que Tim Cook substituia Jensen Huang, que renunciou nesta quinta-feira (12) após escândalo de suposta espionagem por sua amante. Vice de Huang já assumiu o posto de forma interina.
articles.summary: Donald Trump propôs que Tim Cook substituia Jensen Huang, que renunciou nesta quinta-feira (12) após escândalo de suposta espionagem por sua amante. Vice de Huang já assumiu.
articles.body:
Jensen Huang, CEO da Nvidia, ao lado de Donald Trump, presidente dos Estados Unidos, em foto de 8 de outubro de 2026 — Foto: Reuters/Evan Vucci

O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, elogiou nesta quinta-feira (12) o ex-CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, que renunciou ao cargo por conta do escândalo envolvendo sua amante, suspeita de ser espiã chinesa.

Trump disse que Huang fez um "trabalho fantástico" e sugeriu ainda que o ex-CEO da Apple Tim Cook o substituísse à frente da Nvidia.

👉 Trump e Huang desenvolveram uma relação próxima desde o início do atual mandato do republicano. Um dos aliados mais próximos de Trump no Vale do Silício , o executivo se tornou presença frequente na Casa Branca e participou de encontros importantes entre o governo americano e a China ( leia mais abaixo ).

"Agora que o CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang — que fez um trabalho fantástico — renunciou, há apenas um homem para ocupar o seu lugar: Tim Cook, da Apple. Uma lenda substitui outra lenda!", escreveu o norte-americano em sua rede social Truth Social.

Cook deixou a Apple em agosto deste ano, após 15 à frente da companhia.

➡️ Jensen Huang renunciou por conta de um escândalo de suposta espionagem chinesa na Nvidia. O caso veio à tona após a ele admitir que manteve um relacionamento extraconjungal com Alice Huang, ex-executiva suspeita de ser uma espiã chinesa e roubar informações da empresa — a Nvidia é dos Estados Unidos, que proíbe a transferência de tecnologia de chips de IA para a China.

O relacionamento de Huang e aproximação dele com Trump coincidiu com uma série de decisões da Casa Branca favoráveis à fabricante de chips.

Veja os principais episódios da aproximação entre Trump e Huang:

Abril de 2025: Huang participou de um jantar no clube Mar-a-Lago, de Trump, na Flórida. Naquele mês, o governo americano recuou dos planos de restringir a venda de determinados chips da Nvidia para a China.

Dezembro de 2025: Trump autorizou a venda de chips mais avançados da Nvidia para clientes aprovados na China, mediante uma cobrança de 25% sobre as operações.

Maio de 2026: Huang viajou com Trump à China a bordo do Air Force One. Foi a primeira visita de um presidente americano ao país em quase uma década.

Setembro de 2026: O CEO da Nvidia participou do jantar de Estado oferecido por Trump ao presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, na Casa Branca.

Outubro de 2026: Trump concedeu a Huang a Medalha Nacional de Ciência, a mais alta honraria científica dos Estados Unidos.

Os chips da Nvidia são usados para treinar e operar modelos da tecnologia e alimentam muitos dos centros de dados de grandes empresas.

Esses componentes também estão no centro de uma disputa entre os Estados Unidos e a China. Desde 2022, o governo norte-americano mantêm controles de exportação para limitar o acesso chinês aos chips mais avançados da Nvidia e aos equipamentos necessários para produzi-los.

articles.title: Navy kicks off ‘Sea Vigil-26’ to test India’s coastal security preparedness post-26/11
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Navy on Wednesday kicked off the fifth edition of 'Sea Vigil-26', the country’s largest coastal defence exercise to test the maritime
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Navy on Wednesday kicked off the fifth edition of 'Sea Vigil-26', the country’s largest coastal defence exercise to test the maritime security apparatus put in place after the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks.Sea Vigil-26 will span the entire coastline and exclusive economic zone of India, and will involve all coastal states and UTs, along with other maritime stakeholders, including the fishing and coastal communities, the Navy said.The exercise, which will go on till Nov 19, will be conducted in two phases: coastal defence and security readiness evaluation phase, followed by the sea phase on Nov 18 and 19.The exercise is significant in terms of its geographical spread, the number of participating agencies and units, and the range of its objectives. Assets of the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, Coastal Security Police, Customs and other maritime agencies will participate. The conduct of the exercise is also being facilitated by different ministries along other agencies of the Centre and coastal states and UTs.The Sea Vigil exercise was established in response to the Nov 2008 terror strikes in Mumbai when 10 Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) operatives departed Karachi, hijacked Indian trawler Kuber, and killed its captain. Evading detection, they came ashore in Mumbai using inflatable dinghies and carried out a coordinated assault that killed 166 people. Sea Vigil is aimed at preventing such attacks in future.Sea Vigil is also a build-up to the Indian Navy's biennial Theatre Level Readiness Operational Exercise (TROPEX). Together, Sea Vigil and TROPEX address the entire spectrum of maritime security challenges, from coastal defence to operations on the high seas.

articles.title: PATRICK K O’DONNELL: The untold story of America’s female Revolutionary sniper
articles.summary: Benedict Arnold's grueling 350-mile march to Quebec nearly destroyed his force, but Jemima Warner pressed on alone bearing her husband's rifle.
articles.body: Jemima Warner followed her husband into war. She didn’t know she’d take his place when he fell. Jemima’s husband, James Warner, was an original member of the Continental Army and served in the 1st Pennsylvania Rifle Regiment. These crack-shot riflemen were among the best marksmen in Washington’s army. Many had been longhunters who lived and hunted beyond the Allegheny Mountains and often had to battle Native Americans. Their woodcraft, scouting skills and expert marksmanship helped pioneer many aspects of early American special operations. In the fall of 1775, Col. Benedict Arnold tapped them to help move his army through the Maine wilderness to attack Quebec. Handsome, athletic and no more than 25 years old, James Warner was accompanied by his beautiful 17-year-old bride on the ill-fated journey. She was among a small group of women in the force known as camp followers. Two such women marched with the Pennsylvanians. The full story of these remarkable riflemen and the role of the Pennsylvania long rifle in helping win the Revolutionary War can be found in my newest bestselling book, "Revolutionary Snipers: Washington’s Frontier Commandos Whose Marksmanship Forged a New Way of War and Helped Win the Revolution," the third book in a trilogy on the elite units of the war. This groundbreaking look at the Revolutionary War recounts the untold story of the Continental Army’s first soldiers in an immersive "Band of Brothers"-style narrative that puts the reader in the boots of these snipers, who preceded today’s U.S. Army special operators. The book is also the first time the full story of Jemima Warner has been told. AMERICA HAS FOUNDING FATHERS. A CATHOLIC SAINT WAS A FOUNDING MOTHER In general, camp followers, known as "Mollies," had a complicated relationship with the military hierarchy. Many officers despised having these wives, mothers, daughters, mistresses and their children along, believing that they distracted the soldiers, slowed their movements and consumed food that could have fed the men. Others were more pragmatic, noting that the men might not keep fighting if they couldn’t bring their wives. Washington wrote that he "was obliged to give Provisions to the extra Women in these regiments, or lose by Desertion, perhaps to the enemy, some of the oldest and best Soldiers in the Service." EXPERTS FINALLY SOLVE MYSTERY OF TEENAGE REVOLUTIONARY WAR SOLDIER 246 YEARS AFTER HIS DEATH Camp followers also provided valuable services to the Continental Army. Many worked as laundresses, earning rations and small fees for their labor. Others cooked or served as nurses. A few even spied on British camps while working as cooks or laundresses. But the intrepid Jemima found herself doing more. SECRETS OF REVOLUTIONARY WAR BATTLEFIELDS EMERGE 250 YEARS AFTER AMERICA'S FOUNDING She had already marched hundreds of tortuous miles with the company when she found her husband at the foot of a tree, refusing to move, telling her he was "determined to die." The 350-mile march from New England to Canada had become a grueling journey marked by starvation, torture and despair. The battle against the elements — freezing rain; swamps; bogs; snow; whitewater; traversing rivers, ponds and lakes with small, poorly crafted rafts and little to no provisions; drinking contaminated water — had proved deadlier than the British or the Native Americans. Many of the starving, exhausted men found themselves in the same situation as James, but without a wife to urge them on. Jemima managed to press James forward for a few days "until he again sat down." Finding that all her solicitations could not induce him to rise, she had no choice but to leave him. In a final gesture of sacrificial love, the starving woman "placed all the bread in her possession between his legs with a canteen of water." She then took up his beloved rifle and resumed the march alone into the wilderness. When Arnold’s beleaguered force eventually made it to Canada and, together with reinforcements, besieged the city of Quebec, the men were utterly shocked to see Jemima. "The widow of poor James Warner came to our quarters … bearing her husband’s rifle, his powder horn and pouch." She tearfully recounted the tragic story. GEORGE WASHINGTON'S REMARKABLE PRAYER FOR AMERICA STILL RESONATES 250 YEARS LATER The Americans had earlier sent an officer and an enlisted man bearing a white flag of truce into the besieged city of Quebec to offer American terms for surrender. The British had angrily responded by firing upon them with their artillery. CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION So, when the American force demanded Quebec’s surrender for the second time in December 1775, instead of sending their troops under a flag of truce, they sent the intrepid Jemima Warner, fresh from her solo journey through the Maine wilderness, to deliver the message. Crossing no-man’s-land, the same ground where the previous party received enemy fire, Jemima entered the city and delivered the missive. The commander of the Crown forces burned the letter in front of her. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP Fortunately, she returned alive. Courageous to the end, Jemima remained on the front lines. But on Dec. 11, 1775, Jemima Warner was struck and killed by British grapeshot during the siege, making her one of the first documented American women killed in action. articles.title: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow
articles.summary: Later on Thursday, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff will travel to Dublin to meet Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky.
articles.body:
President Volodymyr Zelensky has said Ukraine's military is again facing "systematic" restrictions to Starlink's military-grade satellite service, Starshield, meaning Kyiv is struggling to intercept Russian jet-powered drones.

It came as US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow, a day after the latest talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine wrapped up in Abu Dhabi.

Zelensky told European leaders in Dublin that Ukraine was trying to clear up the Starlink situation with the American side.

But he added "some things" were already clear: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going."

Starshield was developed by Elon Musk's SpaceX company for government and military use. Along with Starlink, it has come to play a vital role in facilitating communication on Ukraine's front line.

A similar issue with connectivity affected the front line in late October and lasted about a week before it was fixed. It remained unclear who had ordered the temporary restrictions on Starlink services at the time, with US officials and SpaceX offering differing explanations.

Zelensky said the current disruption had been ongoing for several days and was "helping the Russians kill more Ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine".

Why is Ukraine so reliant on Starlink and can Europe plug the gap?

Kushner and Witkoff are expected to travel to Dublin to meet Zelensky after their meeting with Putin.

Videos shared by Russian media on Thursday showed the US representatives disembarking a plane and being welcomed by Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev with handshakes and hugs.

Later, they headed to the Kremlin where they met Putin and three of his senior advisors.

In remarks broadcast by Russian media, Putin asked the US envoys to convey his "gratitude" to US First Lady Melania Trump for her involvement in last month's Kherson region ceasefire , which allowed for the evacuation of hundreds of civilians from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

The Russian president then proposed organising a similar five-day ceasefire for Kostyantynivka, a contested front-line Ukrainian city in the eastern region of Donetsk.

Kyiv disputes that Russia fully holds the town, and a truce could help Moscow's troops to make a final push to seize it.

"Considering that they brought in equipment and rotated troops in Oleshky under the guise of a humanitarian operation, it's clear what they want in Kostyantynivka," Ukrainian presidential adviser Dmitry Lytvyn said, adding that the details would need to be "clarified".

The separate in-person meetings with the Russian and Ukrainian presidents were only announced on Wednesday after two days of talks which were framed as centred around the postwar security architecture of Europe.

Nearly five years since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Moscow shows no sign of backing down from its maximalist demands for sovereign Ukrainian territory and for Western countries to give up any future commitment to protecting Kyiv in case of further attacks.

On Thursday, Putin again repeated that the presence of foreign troops in Ukraine was "unacceptable" to Russia, and said Russia would like the Americans to engage with Europe "so that the Europeans can decide what they truly want: peace or war".

During the first years of the war, Europeans cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly.

However, in recent times many have grown concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin, and have been pushing for a seat at the negotiating table.

The talks in Abu Dhabi were led by the Americans and only included Russia and Ukraine, but Kushner said he and Witkoff would ask Putin to "give his blessing" to invite European representatives in future discussions - particularly with regards to the future configuration of their continent's security architecture.

Kushner also urged Europe to "identify one person to speak on their behalf" in the negotiations.

But the Russians have been opposed to the idea, citing Europe's support for Kyiv as an obstacle.

Vladimir Medinsky, who headed the Russian delegation in Abu Dhabi, said he thought all parties had "moved closer to achieving peace" but that now "a lot depends on Ukraine, on the position of the United States, and on whether Europe comes to its senses".

articles.title: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
articles.summary: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.
articles.body:
Nvidia is now facing a scenario few would have considered until very recently - a future without Jensen Huang.

The influential co-founder of the AI chip-making giant resigned on Thursday over reports of extramarital affairs, one of which was with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.

Chief financial officer Colette Kress is in charge, for now, as the tech giant faces one of its biggest challenges - finding the right person to permanently lead the business that Huang helped create more than three decades ago and turned into one of the world's most valuable companies.

We take a look at which candidates have emerged as potential successors.

Colette Kress has been an industry veteran for more than 30 years, having previously held high positions at tech firms like Cisco and Microsoft.

Kress, who also serves as Nvidia's executive vice-president, has seen the firm's transformation from making chips for video games in the early 1990s to becoming an AI semiconductor powerhouse.

She has "fronted every earnings call" alongside Huang and is a "familiar and trusted voice for the market at a time when it badly needs one," said Josh Gilbert, an analyst at investment firm eToro.

But doing the job permanently could be a different story, said Gilbert, as the firm, known for its edge in technology, could want an engineer in the chair.

Another option is Chris Malachowsky, who founded Nvidia alongside Huang and Curtis Priem, and is the only executive that shares the same level of seniority.

Malachowsky has played a key part in developing the company's computing technology.

Ian Buck, who oversees Nvidia's high-performance computing business, has also emerged as a potential candidate if the company is keen to put an engineer in the top job.

Buck was among the early pioneers who helped popularise the use of graphic processors beyond gaming applications.

"He could protect Nvidia's technological edge, but his ability to manage the wider commercial relationships and geopolitical challenges would face scrutiny," said Charu Chanana, investment strategist at investment bank Saxo.

Today, Nvidia's leading processors are widely regarded as the gold standard for AI development.

Huang's children also work at Nvidia in executive positions but are relatively young and inexperienced.

Nvidia is likely to favour an internal appointment initially but could look externally for a more permanent replacement, said Jun Bei Liu, founder and lead portfolio manager at Ten Cap.

Several names of tech entrepreneurs outside of Nvidia have been floated by experts.

Liu said Apple's former chief executive, Tim Cook, could be a possible choice as someone familiar with managing global supply chains, though she questioned whether he would be willing to leave the iPhone maker, where he is the chair.

Liu and Chanana also suggested Rene Haas, chief executive of Arm Holdings, the UK chipmaking giant.

Nvidia's processors are made with the help of chipmakers around the world, including Taiwan's TSMC and South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung.

Haas is familiar with leading a publicly-listed company and would bring semiconductor experience, though Nvidia's business model is considerably different from Arm's, said Chanana.

"The challenge is finding someone who can combine Jensen's technical understanding, strategic vision and relationships across the global technology industry," Liu said.

Ten Cap's Liu had believed it was just a matter of time before Huang would step down as Nvidia's chief executive.

"The issue is no longer simply about personal conduct," she said. "It is about corporate governance, national security concerns and maintaining confidence in the leadership of one of the world's most strategically important companies."

Several major investment firms have downgraded their forecasts for the chip giant - a rare shift given investors' longstanding optimism about the company.

An early indication came as markets opened in New York shortly after Huang's resignation was announced.

Nvidia shares opened down more than 13%, wiping more than half a trillion dollars off the firm's share market value.

Stacy Rasgon, senior analyst in US semiconductors at Bernstein Research, wrote in a note to investors that "our gut tells us we probably haven't fully probed the depths of what might be found here".

Rasgon halved Bernstein's share price target for Nvidia and said: "We've had enough and prefer to watch from the sidelines."

Ray Wang, chief executive of Constellation Research, said the crisis isn't so much an issue for the wider AI industry but rather one for Nvidia itself which has to consider if the person it appoints as its chief executive has the same appeal as Huang.

"That's really what the issue is, because a lot of these partnerships and investments have been made because of the trust with with Jensen," he said.

articles.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
articles.summary: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
articles.body: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter. Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company. In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.” U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday. She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls. A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country. The government also issued her with a stern warning after finding that she had knowingly provided police with inaccurate information to downplay her role in the company. It said that Huang was not investigated for espionage. The country’s Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement that authorities had interviewed Huang and impounded her passport in 2025, but that its requests for cooperation from U.S. authorities had gone unanswered. “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” it said. Investigators concluded in February that there was “insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences,” the statement said, adding that investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals were continuing, related to the shipment of servers via Singapore. Megaspeed, meanwhile, said in the statement Thursday that it has “cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and stands ready to cooperate fully with any other relevant U.S. government authority.” The statement was signed by its chairman and CEO, Tan Yong Pong, who also goes by James Tan. It said that “Megaspeed is committed to working constructively and transparently with the U.S. government.” China has dismissed the spying allegations as “smears.” On Thursday, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that “the U.S. side should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives as a pretext for implementing technological blockades.” Megaspeed did not address the allegations surrounding Alice Huang, but said that “to further reinforce our commitment to compliance, Megaspeed has retained a leading U.S. law firm to lead a comprehensive census of its graphics processing units (GPUs) and independently verify its export control compliance practices.” The company added that it “welcomes appropriate government scrutiny and is committed to demonstrating through concrete actions that it operates responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable U.S. laws.” Nvidia’s stock price has plunged since its 63-year-old chief admitted over the weekend to being “unfaithful” to his wife. Huang quit on Thursday in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships. In a statement, Nvidia named its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO. Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting. The scandal has raised questions about how much U.S. government officials knew about Alice Huang and Megaspeed. In the spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio circulated a memo to officials in the Trump administration outlining how U.S. intelligence showed that the Nvidia CEO was in a romantic relationship with a business executive who was an asset of China’s spy service, according to a person familiar with Nvidia and a former national security official with knowledge of the matter. The New York Times and the Financial Times first reported on this memo. Alice Huang’s precise role and relationship with China’s spy service remain unclear, however. It’s possible she was not a career spy for China’s spy agency, the Ministry of State Security, but was asked to cooperate and share information based on her access to Huang, a former national security official with knowledge of the matter told NBC News. Rep. Jim Himes, D-Conn., ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told NPR that Alice Huang’s role still needed to be clarified. Democrats will soon hold control of both the House and the Senate and, as a result, will have subpoena power. On Wednesday night, as the Nvidia board met, Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Chris Coons, D-Del., announced they had written to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with a request to preserve records on the subject.

The pair discussed some of their favourite musical performances, as well as the role music has played in the King's charity, the King's Trust. The show was recorded in secret last month and will air this Saturday.

Sir Elton has long been a supporter of the trust, most recently donating a pair of his rose-tinted glasses to its 50th anniversary auction this year.

In a trailer for the upcoming episode, the King and Sir Elton are seen laughing together as they chat.

In a voiceover, the singer said he was "excited to hear what he's got to say about music, about the King's Trust and memories that we both share".

The King's Trust - previously known as The Prince's Trust - was established by Charles in 1976 to help young people from disadvantaged backgrounds overcome challenging situations, become employed or launch their own businesses.

During the radio episode, the King called it "an opportunity too good to resist" when he was asked to showcase music from the "talented performers who have so generously supported us over the years, together with some of the newer artists the trust has helped to launch".

The full list of their chosen tracks is under wraps until the episode airs but Skye Newman's Hairdresser, Raye's Joy and Muse's rendition of Feeling Good are said to be among them.

The pair will reminisce about some of the most memorable performances for the trust, from the Wembley Arena rock galas of the 1980s - which Sir Elton participated in - to charity shows at the Royal Albert Hall and pop concerts in Hyde Park.

The episode was recorded at Apple Music Studios - which hosts the show - in Battersea Power Station when the King and Sir Elton visited for the launch of the Apple x King's Trust Creative Labs.

articles.title: Nvidia board weighs Jensen Huang’s future: Can it remove its founder?
articles.summary: CEO of chip maker is under scrutiny after reports of affairs, including a relationship with an alleged Chinese spy.
articles.body:
Jensen Huang may be ousted as the CEO of Nvidia after the tech giant lost more than $600bn in market value this week, following reports that he had extramarital affairs with two women, including a businesswoman accused of spying for China.

Nvidia’s board of directors met late on Wednesday to decide whether to remove Huang, who cofounded the $4.2 trillion company, which supplies most of the chips used for advanced artificial intelligence (AI).

Huang, 63, admitted on Sunday in a memo to staff that he had been unfaithful to his wife, following the reports of a relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed whom United States officials suspect of working for Chinese intelligence, a claim China has denied.

On Wednesday, The New York Times reported that Huang had another extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of healthcare, who reports to him. The newspaper cited five people who worked at the company.

Nvidia’s shares fell more than 8 percent in after-hours trading on Wednesday after The Wall Street Journal reported that the board was preparing to oust Huang.

Under Nvidia’s bylaws, Huang can be removed “with or without cause” by a majority vote of directors.

The board has 11 members, and all but Huang are considered independent.

Huang owns about 3.6 percent of the company, according to LSEG data, and has no majority voting control. That sets Nvidia apart from other tech giants.

Huang does not have majority voting control, unlike executives at other companies in the sector, such as Meta and SpaceX.

Nvidia also has no board chair, which Steve Okun, a Singapore-based geopolitical analyst, called “pretty astounding”.

“But what this certainly shows is the utter lack of appropriate governance at Nvidia,” Okun told Al Jazeera. “This should never have been allowed to happen.”

On Sunday, the board launched an independent investigation into whether Huang had been “the target of a foreign intelligence effort”, while saying it had “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team”.

Bloomberg reported that the board had been working with an outside firm to identify possible replacements.

Huang has never named a successor, but the Reuters news agency reported that analysts see two likely internal candidates: Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress and engineer Ian Buck.

Lian Jye Su, chief analyst at the technology research group Omdia, described Buck as “a highly regarded industry veteran”, but said: “This remains a speculation until the final decision”.

What would his departure mean for Nvidia?

Huang cofounded Nvidia in 1993 and has led it ever since, turning a maker of graphics chips for video games into the world’s leading supplier of processors that power AI.

Nvidia controls an estimated 80 to 90 percent of the market for the chips used to run advanced AI, and is the world’s second-most valuable company after Apple.

“Jensen is no doubt the de facto leader of Nvidia,” Su told Al Jazeera, pointing to his “willingness to make early bets, identify major technological shifts, and steer the company in the right direction”.

Su said the impact on short-term continuity would be minimal, but a new leader could change the company’s long-term direction, “as a different CEO may have a different view of the future”.

“The market is starting to price Nvidia without its founder as the likely outcome, not a tail risk,” Armina Rosenberg, cofounder of Minotaur Capital, which holds Nvidia shares, told Reuters.

For Okun, the question is whether Huang is bigger than Nvidia, or whether the company has become so unique in what it makes that it no longer needs him.

“That’s the question everybody’s going to try and figure out from a business perspective,” he said.

The alleged spy link “spices up the story quite a bit”, Okun said, adding that even without it, Nvidia faced “an extraordinarily damaging question”: Why Megaspeed received so many of its chips, and where they went.

Megaspeed bought about $4.8bn worth of equipment from Nvidia, according to The New York Times.

US authorities have been investigating the company since 2024 over suspicions that it helped China obtain advanced Nvidia chips in breach of export controls, an allegation Megaspeed denies.

But Carsten Holz, an expert on the Chinese economy at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, told Al Jazeera that the likelihood that Huang “could pass on significant technical information to another person, whether a spy or not, would seem extremely low”.

On Monday, US President Donald Trump said the FBI was looking into the matter, adding that Huang had told him he had “absolutely no idea” the woman was an alleged spy.

Three Republican House committee chairs have asked Huang to attend a closed-door briefing on November 18. He faces a possible subpoena if he does not respond, Reuters reported.

Okun said Huang “certainly has to take a leave of absence”.

It is also unclear whether Huang will join Trump at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in the Chinese city of Shenzhen on November 18-19.

He travelled with Trump to Beijing in May, but his participation is now in doubt, the South China Morning Post reported. During the May trip, an agreement was signed to allow Nvidia to sell its H200 AI chips to several approved Chinese companies.

Asked on Sunday whether Huang would take part in the summit, Trump said: “I don’t know, but I’d certainly take him.”

Huang had lobbied Trump to lift some of the restrictions on chip exports to China imposed by President Joe Biden. Beijing is one of the biggest buyers of Nvidia chips in the world.

articles.title: Xi Jinping says Taiwan’s ‘complete reunification’ with China will happen
articles.summary: Chinese president says the tide of history ‘cannot be stopped’ as Taiwan rejects ‘one country, two systems’.
articles.body:
Chinese President Xi Jinping has said the tide of history cannot be stopped, while urging peaceful “reunification” with Taiwan.

Resolving the Taiwan question is an “unwavering historical mission” of China’s Communist Party, Xi said in a speech at Beijing’s Great Hall of the People on Thursday.

“The tide of history ⁠⁠cannot be stopped,” Xi added.

“The complete reunification of the motherland must be realised, and it will certainly be realised.”

China views democratically governed Taiwan as ⁠⁠its own territory, despite Taipei’s strong rejection of that claim, and has repeatedly offered a “one country, two systems” model of autonomy not supported by any major Taiwanese political party.

Xi’s comments came in a speech on the 160th birthday of revolutionary hero Sun Yat-sen, who helped lead a 1911 ‌‌revolt that ended centuries of rule by emperors and empresses and ushered in the Republic of China.

Taiwan’s government dismissed the remarks.

Its Mainland Affairs Council said neither the government nor Taiwan’s people could accept “one country, two systems”, which would ultimately mean submitting to the Communist Party’s rule.

“As for the wording on Taiwan unification, it isn’t much different from the past,” council spokesperson Liang Wen-chieh told reporters.

Xi said China adheres to “peaceful reunification and the policy of ‘one country, two systems'” and is willing to talk to Taiwan while upholding the “one China principle”, or Beijing’s position that both sides of the Taiwan Strait are one country.

All Chinese, including those in Taiwan, should join hands to jointly oppose Taiwan independence “separatist” forces and strive for peaceful development of cross-Strait ties, Xi added.

Although Xi did not mention the use of force, which China has never renounced for Taiwan, China’s military operates around the island on a daily basis and is extending its reach further into the Pacific.

Taiwan’s defence ministry said it had detected 29 Chinese military aircraft, including J-16 fighter jets and drones, carrying out a “joint combat ⁠⁠readiness patrol” around Taiwan in conjunction with Chinese warships, starting on Thursday.

Xi’s speech comes a ⁠⁠week ahead of the APEC summit in China’s southern tech hub of Shenzhen, where he is due to again meet US President Donald Trump, and also a little more than two weeks before important local elections in Taiwan.

The Chinese president made a state visit to Washington in September, during which he told Trump to show “prudence” over Taiwan and urged the US to oppose the island’s independence.

Washington had already paused a $14bn weapons purchase by Taiwan in May, with Trump calling it a “very good negotiating chip” in dealings with China, which raised fears that Taiwan’s security could be traded away.

articles.title: Ancient burial site packed with treasures plus 38 bodies discovered after centuries
articles.summary: A 600-year-old burial complex at Chan Chan, Peru, contained 38 bodies, metal headdresses and ceremonial objects, including one skeleton whose unusual position puzzled experts.
articles.body: Archaeologists in Peru have uncovered a 600-year-old burial complex holding 38 bodies — including one skeleton whose unusual position has raised questions about the possibility of human sacrifice. The graves were discovered at Chan Chan, an ancient pre-Incan city near Trujillo, Peru, roughly 350 miles north of Lima. Peru's Ministry of Culture announced the discovery earlier this fall, saying the nearly intact Chimú burial site had remained hidden for over six centuries. COLOSSAL TOMB TIED TO ALEXANDER THE GREAT REVEALED BY OFFICIALS: 'UNIQUE AND MAGNIFICENT' Images shared with Fox News Digital by officials at the Ministry of Culture show an assortment of ancient ceramic vessels, including decorated jugs and pottery with sculpted figures. Other photos offer an overhead view of the burial complex, revealing its network of chambers, walls and stairways. The burial complex contained three chambers, including a central chamber holding one individual surrounded by artifacts made from shell and metal, according to the Ministry of Culture. Another chamber contained weapons and metal emblems, while a third held 20 bodies. Archaeologists reported finding 38 individuals across the site. 7,000-YEAR-OLD BONES UNCOVERED AT CONSTRUCTION SITE IN STARTLING FIND One skeleton stood out because it was buried fully extended, unlike typical Chimú burials, in which bodies were placed in bent or seated positions. "This unusual characteristic raises new questions about the circumstances surrounding the individual's death and has led researchers to consider several hypotheses, including the possibility of a sacrificial ritual or an extreme difference in social status compared with the other individuals buried in the same space," the ministry said in a statement translated from Spanish. The burial goods included metal headdresses, earrings, necklaces, carved wooden boxes and ceremonial objects made from seashells and quartz. Some of the buried individuals also had red pigment on their heads, which officials said was "used exclusively in high-ranking burials in Andean societies." CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER Officials added that the fragile remains must be carefully documented before they can be removed from the site. "Because the skeletal and organic remains are extremely fragile after centuries of deterioration caused by time and coastal humidity, scientific protocols require that no evidence be removed without first conducting a thorough examination and documentation of its original context," the statement said. Researchers will first take hundreds of photographs to create a detailed 3D model of the burial site before carefully removing the remains and artifacts by hand. Jorge Meneses, an archaeologist with Peru's Ministry of Culture, said in a statement that the discovery offers a rare opportunity to study ancient Chimú burials that have remained largely undisturbed. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS "What was known about elite Chimú tombs before this discovery came from funerary platforms that had been looted and destroyed since colonial times, with disturbed and incomplete archaeological contexts and valuable objects displayed in collections and museums," Meneses said. "Now, archaeologists have the opportunity to study the individuals and artifacts exactly as they were placed inside this platform nearly 600 years ago," he added. Peru, a country rich in ancient history, has yielded numerous archaeological discoveries in recent years. Last summer, utility workers digging a natural gas line in Lima, Peru, discovered a well-preserved, 1,000-year-old female mummy buried just 20 inches below the surface. articles.title: Pakistan releases two sisters of ex-PM Imran Khan from jail
articles.summary: Uzma and Noreen released from a Lahore jail but Aleema Khan still detained nearly two months after their arrest.
articles.body:
⁠Uzma Khan and ⁠Noreen Niazi Khan, sisters ⁠of Pakistan’s jailed ‌former Prime Minister Imran Khan, have been ⁠released from ⁠prison, their lawyer and Khan’s political party said.

“Dr Uzma Khan and Ms Noreen Niazi have been released. They have arrived home safely,” lawyer Mudassar Umer said in a post on X on Thursday.

The sisters were released from Kot Lakhpat maximum-security prison in Lahore, nearly two months after they were arrested. A third sister, Aleema Khan, who was detained the same day as Uzma and Noreen, remains in jail, Imran Khan party’s the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) said.

“Aleema Khan remains behind bars. The release of two sisters does not end the injustice or erase the suffering inflicted on Imran Khan’s family,” PTI leader and close Khan confidant Zulfiqar Bukhari told Al Jazeera.

“The demand is clear: No selective relief, no intimidation, and no further persecution.”

Uzma Khan’s son, Wali Khan, called for an explanation as to why his mother had been detained for ⁠53 days and then released, saying the decisions were ⁠not based in law. “Their jailing was arbitrary, and so is their release,” he said in a post on X.

The sisters were arrested and placed under 30-day detention orders a week before a planned PTI protest march on September 27 to demand their brother’s release.

Imran Khan, 74, has been jailed since August 2023 following a series of convictions his party calls politically motivated. All but one have since been suspended or overturned on appeal.

Concerns over his health, in particular the condition of his right eye , which has required months of specialist treatment, have driven the PTI campaign to demand his release.

His sisters’ release comes a day after Khan was taken to hospital in Islamabad, where ⁠he was given medical treatment.

Pakistan’s government said it detained the sisters because they could have been a threat to ‌law and order ahead of the planned march on Islamabad, which ultimately did not go ahead.

The federal government suspended the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa provincial government, led by Khan’s party, that had been organising the demonstration.

articles.title: Leave Texas, come to Florida: Congressman invites Elon Musk to shift base, says 'Sunshine State' does not investigate or punish success
articles.summary: Republican US Representative Carlos Giménez has invited Elon Musk to move Tesla’s headquarters to Florida after Democrats scored historic victories in
articles.body: Republican US Representative Carlos Giménez has invited Elon Musk to move Tesla’s headquarters to Florida after Democrats scored historic victories in Texas in the November midterm elections. In a letter to Musk, Giménez formally pitched the Sunshine State as a destination for the billionaire’s automotive and energy company, arguing that Florida offers a more business-friendly environment where “innovation, entrepreneurship, and economic freedom are celebrated.”“With the recent election of self-described Democratic Socialists to positions of power in Texas, I share your concerns about excessive government interference, politically motivated investigations, and policies that punish success. No company should face political retaliation for creating jobs, investing in American innovation, and contributing to our nation’s prosperity,” Giménez wrote.“Florida offers a fundamentally different approach. Our state has championed lower taxes, responsible regulation, and the freedom to innovate without unnecessary government intrusion. While others seek to investigate and punish success, Florida welcomes it.”Texas Democrats registered major victories across the state last week, sweeping statewide races and taking control of the Texas House for the first time in more than two decades.Democratic state Representative Gina Hinojosa defeated Republican Governor Greg Abbott, marking the first Democratic victory in a Texas gubernatorial election since 1990. Democratic state Representative James Talarico also defeated Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton, securing the party's first US Senate victory in Texas since 1988.Democratic US Representative Greg Casar, a former member of the Democratic Socialists of America, retained his seat in Texas' 37th Congressional District. In Austin, self-described democratic socialist Misael Ramos advanced to a December 12 runoff for a City Council seat.Florida, meanwhile, remained firmly Republican. None of the state's 28 US House seats changed hands, and Republicans won all statewide contests. But Democrats made gains in Florida House races, preventing Republicans from retaining their four-year supermajority.Giménez argued that Florida's political and ideological environment would offer Musk a more favourable setting to expand his business empire. Musk spent $458 million supporting Republican candidates in the midterm elections, but an overwhelming share of those he backed lost.The lawmaker, who previously served as Miami-Dade County Mayor, specifically highlighted South Florida as an attractive location for Tesla's expansion.Carlos Gimenez' letter to Elon Musk“As a gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean, our region boasts world-class infrastructure, a growing technology sector, and a highly skilled, diverse workforce ready to support Tesla’s future,” the letter said.“Your leadership has transformed the automotive and technology industries and demonstrated what American ingenuity can accomplish when entrepreneurs are empowered to succeed. That pioneering spirit is exactly what we embrace in Florida.”Musk has previously expressed an interest in Miami. In 2023, he made headlines after recommending the city to a fellow Texas resident who asked on X about relocating to a place offering opportunities for cryptocurrency and cannabis enthusiasts, along with networking and recreational options.Several other prominent Florida politicians have also tried to persuade Musk to move his businesses to the state.In April 2022, US Representative Jimmy Patronis, then Florida's Chief Financial Officer, and former Jacksonville Mayor Lenny Curry urged Musk to relocate his social media platform, then known as Twitter, to Florida.Former Miami Mayor Francis Suarez made a similar pitch a month later. Suarez had previously spoken with Musk about developing underground tunnels to ease traffic congestion in Miami.Giménez had made a similar appeal in December 2022, when he wrote to Musk asking him to shift Twitter's headquarters from San Francisco to Miami.Musk eventually moved the social media company's headquarters to Bastrop, Texas, around 40 minutes from Tesla's Gigafactory in Austin.Giménez recently secured a fourth term representing Florida's 28th Congressional District, which covers parts of southern Miami-Dade County and the Florida Keys in Monroe County. He defeated Democratic veteran Phil Ehr by seven percentage points in a rematch.Where does Elon Musk live?Musk moved his personal base from California to Texas in 2021. His residences are reportedly in the Austin area and near SpaceX's South Texas operations.Tesla moved its corporate headquarters from California to Austin in 2021. The city is also home to Gigafactory Texas, a massive manufacturing facility producing the Model Y and Cybertruck. The factory covers more than 10 million square feet of floor space and is one of the company's major production hubs.South Texas is home to SpaceX's Starbase facility near Boca Chica, where the company develops and launches its Starship rockets. Musk moved SpaceX's headquarters to Starbase in 2024Bastrop County, outside Austin, houses the headquarters of The Boring Company, his tunnelling venture, as well as a major SpaceX facility manufacturing hardware for Starlink, the satellite internet service. The area also has offices for X, formerly Twitter, which moved its headquarters to Bastrop. articles.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills at least 6, including doctor and child, Palestinian officials say
articles.summary: The strike killed a 52-year-old doctor and a 13-year-old boy who was supposed to have surgery. A total of 40 people were injured in the Israeli strike.
articles.body: An Israeli strike on a hospital in southern Gaza overnight Wednesday killed at least six people, including a doctor and a child, Palestinian officials say. The strike on Nasser Hospital shortly after midnight hit the complex’s surgery unit, according to a Gaza Civil Defense spokesman. The attack tore through part of the hospital in the dark of night, Ezz Eddine Abu Sabha said, leaving charred debris scattered across the destroyed unit. The strike killed 52-year-old Dr. Rizk Abu Shaira, Abu Sabha said, as well as a 13-year-old boy who was supposed to have surgery. A total of 40 people were injured in the Israeli strike, including two doctors who are in critical condition. “People of the world… where can the people of Gaza go? Tents flood, cliffs collapse onto children, and hospitals are bombed with people inside. There is no time for blankets – or tears – to dry,” Dr. Munir Al-Bursh, director-general of Gaza’s Health Ministry, wrote on Facebook. “Gaza does not ask the world to count its dead… It demands protection for those still alive,” he added. Footage from inside the hospital showed two bombs, one of which failed to explode. A label on the bomb identified it as a US-manufactured GBU-39/B, a 250-pound bomb that has been supplied to Israel. “I was asleep when suddenly I was covered with dust and glass,” said Atiya Abu Basir, an elderly patient at the hospital. “I couldn’t walk because I just had surgery.” Despite a nominal US-brokered ceasefire signed more than a year ago, Israel has carried out near-daily strikes in Gaza. According to the United Nations, Israeli forces have killed more than 1,400 people in Gaza since the ceasefire, and there is no fully functioning hospital in the devastated enclave. “They say there is a ceasefire. Where is there a ceasefire? Since the ceasefire, there are more massacres,” said Maryam Abu Hatab, whose brother was killed in the strike. “There are massacres every day in markets, in universities, in the streets. The donkey carts stood by us more than the world’s countries.” In a statement, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said they targeted the commander of Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade, Muhammad Abu Ismail, as well as “additional terrorists who were hiding inside the Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis.” The IDF said he planned and advanced attacks on Israeli forces and civilians. CNN reached out to the IDF to ask if Abu Ismail had been killed in the strike and what measures were taken to reduce the risk to civilians. Board of Peace chides Israel Earlier this week, the US-led Board of Peace, which is tasked with overseeing the ceasefire in Gaza, chided Israel for what it called an “insufficient” response to Gaza flooding. Seasonal rains swamped tens of thousands of tents across the coastal enclave, where nearly two million Palestinians are displaced, according to the United Nations. “The urgent entry and distribution of essential shelter, sanitation, drainage, and other winterization supplies is critical to protecting civilians,” the board said in a statement Monday, calling on Israel to allow more temporary shelters, waste management, and other supplies. Israel said that more than 91,000 tents had entered Gaza ahead winter, but refused to allow in the heavy equipment needed for large-scale cleanup and rubble removal efforts. “The reconstruction of Gaza can only begin after Hamas fully disarms,” said Israel’s Coordinator for Government Activities in the Territories.
